brief: The 5 scalp habits dermatologists wish you'd adopt this year.

slots.author: DR. AMARA CHEN
slots.subtitle: BOARD CERTIFIED RITUALS FOR GROWTH AND BALANCE

slots.author: DR. AMARA CHEN
slots.title: THE FOUNDATION
slots.body: Your scalp is an extension of your facial skin. These dermatologist-backed practices transform hair health from the root. Small changes create lasting results.

slots.author: DR. AMARA CHEN
slots.title: EXFOLIATE WEEKLY
slots.body: Product buildup and dead skin block follicles and stunt growth. A gentle weekly acid or enzyme cleanse keeps the scalp balanced and breathable.

slots.author: DR. AMARA CHEN
slots.title: MASSAGE DAILY
slots.body: Two minutes of gentle pressure boosts microcirculation and nutrient delivery. This simple ritual supports stronger, thicker hair over time.

slots.author: DR. AMARA CHEN
slots.title: SHIELD FROM SUN
slots.body: Your scalp burns easily and UV damage weakens the follicle bulb. Wear a hat or apply SPF mist along your parting every morning.

slots.author: DR. AMARA CHEN
slots.title: RINSE COOL
slots.body: Hot water strips natural oils and triggers excess sebum production. Lukewarm rinses calm irritation and help maintain a healthy moisture barrier.

slots.author: DR. AMARA CHEN
slots.title: EXTEND WASH DAY
slots.body: Over-cleansing disrupts your microbiome and causes rebound oiliness. Space shampoos two to three days apart to let natural hydration regulate.

slots.author: DR. AMARA CHEN
slots.headline: START TODAY
slots.body: Book a personalized consultation. Build your custom scalp regimen with expert guidance.
